sentences.en: Google and library databases jumble different forms of information together.
sentences.zh: 谷歌和图书馆的数据库将不同形式的信息混杂在一起。

sentences.en: Please change your database to reflect the new address as follows.
sentences.zh: 请在数据库中更新新的地址。

sentences.en: I have a large body of information in my computer database.
sentences.zh: 我的电脑数据库里有大量的信息。

mnemonic: 合成词：data（数据）+base（基础）→数据库
